description: Whiplash on the Grid: Emulation of a Cyber-Physical Attack Misusing Inverter-Based Resources in a Distribution Grid – Codes and Dataset Package (DSN 2026) is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Arman Aghaei Attar, Kaibin Bao (Karlsruhe Institute of Technology). DSN 2026 Artifact – Paper 221 Whiplash on the Grid: Emulation of a Cyber-Physical Attack Misusing Inverter-Based Resources in a Distribution Grid OverviewThis artifact accompanies the accepted DSN 2026 paper and enables reproduction of the main figures and summary tables presented in the study. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
